stages.blurb: Renaming a file is an API call. Downloading a popular file often hits a nearby CDN.
Permissions live with the folder names. The file itself is uploaded in chunks on a separate path.
Skip bytes you already stored. Folder lists you open all day sit in a cache.
Names and sharing rules in a database; the actual chunks in object storage.
Virus scan and previews happen after upload succeeds, so the app can say “saved” quickly.
Other devices get told there is a new version. Search is an index, not the file warehouse.
